subject: Consolidating Remittance Instructions & Split-entity Allocation — Helix pilot
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: finance@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Remittance instructions for multi-entity billing pilot

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement team (cc'd) asked for a concrete remittance plan for the pilot so we can wire payments to the correct legal entities and split invoice lines to our cost centers. A few constraints from our side: 

- Helix US (EIN: 12-3456789) needs invoices for product usage billed net of VAT for its U.S. operations.
- Helix Europe (VAT: EU123456) requires VAT-inclusive invoices and separate invoice numbers for reporting in our AP system.
- We have three internal cost centers that must appear on the invoice lines: ClinicalOps, R&D, and Platform.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) produce a single invoice that contains split lines mapped to different legal entities, (2) generate separate remit addresses per entity on the invoice (and corresponding bank account details), and (3) produce a CSV remittance mapping export that our AP can ingest?

We'd like to close the payment flow before the pilot kickoff on June 1. I attached a spreadsheet with our preferred cost center mapping.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Helix Health
Attachments: helix_costcenter_example.xlsx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: finance@helixhealth.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Remittance instructions for multi-entity billing pilot

Elena —

Appreciate the clear requirements and the example mapping. Short answer: yes, we can support what you described but there are a couple implementation details to lock down. High-level plan: 

1) Invoice construction: Redwood can emit a single invoice PDF that contains line items tagged with entity and cost center, and we can include separate remit blocks (bank wires / ACH) per legal entity on that PDF. For bookkeeping we also produce per-entity invoice stubs (for customers who ingest them separately).

2) Remit/Cash application: We'll provide a CSV (HLX-friendly schema) that maps invoice_line_id -> remit_entity -> bank_account_id -> cost_center. That CSV will be exportable from the Console and can be POSTed to your SFTP or pulled from a secure bucket.

3) VAT handling: We'll surface VAT-inclusive and VAT-exempt totals per entity depending on the legal entity flags you provide.

Next steps I propose: 
- I'll loop in Karthik (billing/ledgers) and Marissa (collections) to draft the exact CSV schema and sample files.
- If you can sign off on the mapping in the attached spreadsheet, we will produce a sample invoice + CSV by Monday (May 24).

Attaching a quick Remit Mapping template for your review.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attachments: Helix_remit_mapping_v2.xlsx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Remittance instructions for multi-entity billing pilot

Team — forwarding Elena's ask. Key requirements summarized below; can you review and propose the ledger routing and CSV schema? We need a sample invoice + CSV for Helix by EOD Monday, May 24 so they can test ingest with AP.

Summary:
- Two legal entities (Helix US / Helix Europe) with different tax handling.
- Three internal cost centers that must appear on invoice line level.
- Single invoice PDF preferred but with per-entity remit blocks and per-entity invoice numbers for reporting.
- CSV mapping: invoice_line_id, invoice_number, line_amount, cost_center_code, remit_entity, remit_account_id, vat_flag, tax_amount

Constraints/things to flag:
- For EU entity we need VAT-inclusive line totals and separate invoice numbering sequence.
- For cash application automation we should provide both bank account id and structured wiring/bacs details for each remit block.

Can someone take lead and produce the sample files?

Thanks,
Jonas
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Remittance instructions for multi-entity billing pilot

Arguing from the ledger perspective — proposed approach: 

1) Invoice generation: Create a master invoice ID (e.g., M-20270524-HLX-001) and then derive per-entity invoice numbers (US-2027-XXXX, EU-2027-YYYY). The PDF will show the master invoice header with three line items tagged with cost_center codes (CLIN, RND, PLAT). Each line will include a remit_entity tag in the metadata.

2) CSV schema: I agree with the suggested header; adding two fields: remit_reference (string) and gl_account (string) so Helix can map to their chart of accounts. Sample CSV attached (HLX-entity-mapping-20270523.csv).

3) Tax logic: For EU entity, compute VAT at the line level and include both VAT and VAT-excluded subtotals. For US entity, mark VAT as zero and include tax_exemption flag if applicable.

4) Delivery: We can expose an SFTP drop for Helix with two files per invoice cycle: invoice_master_<id>.pdf and invoice_mapping_<id>.csv. The Console will retain a copy and we can also push to the HubSpot deal record (link below).

Open question for Marissa: when Helix pays to multiple bank accounts for the same invoice, do we want to auto-apply partial receipts to each remit_entity or wait for them to indicate which amounts map to which entity? My recommendation: auto-apply by remit_account_id if payment reference matches remit_reference; otherwise hold and send an exception to collections for manual allocation.

-Karthik

Attachments: HLX-entity-mapping-20270523.csv
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, finance@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated remit mapping and next steps for Helix pilot

Elena —

Thanks for the patience. Please find attached: (1) Helix_remit_mapping_v2.xlsx (human-friendly) and (2) HLX-entity-mapping-20270523.csv (sample CSV export). Summary of how Redwood will handle the pilot: 

- You will receive a master invoice PDF that shows all line items and includes separate remit blocks (US bank details / EU bank details) and per-entity invoice numbers.
- We will drop the matching CSV to a secure SFTP every billing run. The CSV fields include invoice_line_id, invoice_number, line_amount, cost_center_code, remit_entity, remit_account_id, remit_reference, gl_account, vat_flag, tax_amount.
- For cash application we will auto-match payments by remit_reference -> remit_account_id. Any ambiguous payments will create an exception ticket and notify Marissa's collections queue.

Action items for Helix: 
1) Confirm the attached cost center codes (CLIN / RND / PLAT) map to your internal chart of accounts and provide GL codes if different.
2) Confirm you want the files delivered to SFTP (we can also support secure HTTPS pull).
3) If OK, please sign the remit mapping with DocuSign (link included) so our ops team can enable the SFTP feed and bank details.

Once we get your confirmation we will enable the export and produce a test invoice + CSV for your AP to ingest by Thursday, May 27.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference, Inc.
